lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Day two. The Department of Unfortunate Outcomes no longer officially existed. This was the day humanity chose to be contacted.

lines.speaker: VERA
lines.text: Gary. We are receiving a transmission.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Not now.

lines.speaker: VERA
lines.text: It originates outside the solar system.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Still not now.

lines.speaker: VERA
lines.text: It is addressed to the highest authority on Earth.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Then why is it ringing here?

lines.speaker: VERA
lines.text: A typo. Our postal code is one digit away from the United Nations.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Of course it is.

lines.speaker: Dolores
lines.text: Gary! There's an alien in the lobby! He's so tall! He brought a gift!

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Is he on the visitor list?

lines.speaker: Dolores
lines.text: I'll check!

lines.speaker: Brenda
lines.text: Name, species, reason for visit?

lines.speaker: Ixx
lines.text: Ambassador Ixx. Vael. First contact.

lines.speaker: Brenda
lines.text: There are only ten boxes for the name.

lines.speaker: Ixx
lines.text: Then I shall be Ixx of Vael.

lines.speaker: Ixx
lines.text: People of Earth. Eleven days ago we detected a singularity in your accounting department.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: That was ours.

lines.speaker: Ixx
lines.text: It vanished. My civilization required four thousand years to achieve that.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: We fed it paperwork.

lines.speaker: Ixx
lines.text: ...Teach us.

lines.speaker: Ixx
lines.text: Your species has weaponized bureaucracy. We bow before you.

lines.speaker: VERA
lines.text: Technically correct.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: It's not a weapon. It's a Tuesday.

lines.speaker: Ixx
lines.text: Unfortunately, protocol requires your formal reply within one Earth day. Otherwise your planet is declared unclaimed and reassigned.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Reassigned to whom?

lines.speaker: Ixx
lines.text: A mining company.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: What do we have to file?

lines.speaker: Ixx
lines.text: Form 7-J. Fourteen pages. Notarized.

lines.speaker: Brenda
lines.text: Notarized by whom?

lines.speaker: Ixx
lines.text: A neutral party.

lines.speaker: VERA
lines.text: Dave is a notary.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Dave is in Portugal.

lines.speaker: Dolores
lines.text: I'll ask Dave! Does he have Wi-Fi?

lines.speaker: Brenda
lines.text: Out of toner.

lines.speaker: Ixx
lines.text: We have eleven minutes.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Nobody panic.

lines.speaker: Dolores
lines.text: Eleven minutes!

lines.speaker: Vendor
lines.text: Thank you for calling Toner Express. Your order is important to us. Estimated delivery: six to eight weeks. Press one to hear this message again.

lines.speaker: Ixx
lines.text: Form rejected. Signed by an intern.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: I'm the only one here.

lines.speaker: VERA
lines.text: Gary. A legally non-existent entity cannot be rejected. It can only be pending.

lines.speaker: Ixx
lines.text: ...Pending is acceptable. Review time: six hundred years.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Earth was not destroyed. It was placed on hold. Estimated wait time: six hundred years. Gary's mood: unchanged. Next time on Department of Unfortunate Outcomes: Dolores Files a Complaint.
